findings.text: The figure tier is judged by review_record_refusals, which only requires findings to be a list, so a stored figure review carrying an undisposed blocking finding counts as complete; the lander attempts the land and the refusal arrives one step later from promotion_checks._require_no_undisposed_blocking_figure_finding inside the same crew land step, so the run is not merged but its record names a land failure rather than the finding the code tier would have named.

_review_for_tier re-reads the figure record through review.read_review instead of extending promotion_checks._newest_figure_review, so the lander does not inherit that owner's unreadable-record distinction and a figure record that cannot be parsed is treated as an absent one.
The awaiting record's review_tier holds code or figure while review_tier on the run record and ledger is the light/full/none sweep tier, so one key name carries two vocabularies on the same pointer.

stale_head is documented as naming a revision, but the caller passes stale, which is str(exc) when a tier's store read raises, so an exception message is persisted in a field a reader compares as a revision.
